title: Tiny, cute sailing boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky gradient hint (very subtle, not black) -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE9A8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF6D6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sail2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD1DC'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE4EC'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3AB0E0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1E7FBF'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M6 72 Q18 68 30 72 Q42 76 54 72 Q66 68 78 72 Q90 76 94 72 L94 86 Q82 90 70 86 Q58 82 46 86 Q34 90 22 86 Q10 82 6 86 Z' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <!-- water highlights -->
  <path d='M12 76 Q20 73 28 76' stroke='#7FD4F5' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 78 Q54 75 62 78' stroke='#7FD4F5' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 74 Q78 72 84 74' stroke='#7FD4F5' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M18 70 Q20 64 32 63 L64 63 Q76 64 80 70 Q70 74 50 74 Q30 74 18 70 Z' fill='#E8452C'/>
  <path d='M18 70 Q30 74 50 74 Q70 74 80 70 L80 72 Q70 76 50 76 Q30 76 18 72 Z' fill='#B52E1A'/>
  <!-- hull stripe -->
  <path d='M22 67 Q32 64.5 48 64.5 L64 64.5 Q72 65 76 67' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='24' width='3' height='40' rx='1.5' fill='#C8925A'/>
  <rect x='48' y='24' width='1.5' height='40' rx='0.75' fill='#E8B87A'/>

  <!-- main sail -->
  <path d='M51 26 Q70 40 70 62 L51 62 Z' fill='url(#sail)'/>
  <path d='M51 26 Q70 40 70 62 L51 62 Z' fill='none' stroke='#F5C842' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- sail seams -->
  <path d='M53 34 Q62 42 63 62' stroke='#F0D080' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M53 44 Q58 50 58 62' stroke='#F0D080' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none'/>

  <!-- jib sail (front) -->
  <path d='M47 28 Q36 42 38 62 L47 62 Z' fill='url(#sail2)'/>
  <path d='M47 28 Q36 42 38 62 L47 62 Z' fill='none' stroke='#F5A0B8' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- flag -->
  <path d='M49 20 L49 25 L58 22.5 Z' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#FFD166'/>

  <!-- tiny sun -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='26' r='8' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='26' r='6' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <g stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='82' y1='15' x2='82' y2='12'/>
    <line x1='82' y1='37' x2='82' y2='40'/>
    <line x1='71' y1='26' x2='68' y2='26'/>
    <line x1='93' y1='26' x2='96' y2='26'/>
    <line x1='74.2' y1='18.2' x2='72' y2='16'/>
    <line x1='89.8' y1='33.8' x2='92' y2='36'/>
    <line x1='89.8' y1='18.2' x2='92' y2='16'/>
    <line x1='74.2' y1='33.8' x2='72' y2='36'/>
  </g>

  <!-- little clouds -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='22' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#E8F4FF'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='21' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#F4FAFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='23' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#F4FAFF'/>
</svg>
